films.title: Superstar: The Karen Carpenter Story
films.overview: The final 17 years of American singer and musician Karen Carpenter, performed almost entirely by modified Barbie dolls.

films.title: Velvet Goldmine
films.overview: Almost a decade since larger-than-life glam-rock enigma Brian Slade disappeared from public eye, an investigative journalist is on assignment to uncover the truth behind his former idol.

films.title: I'm Not There
films.overview: Six actors portray six personas of music legend Bob Dylan in scenes depicting various stages of his life, chronicling his rise from unknown folksinger to international icon and revealing how Dylan constantly reinvented himself.

films.title: Far from Heaven
films.overview: In 1950s Connecticut, a housewife's life is upended by a marital crisis and mounting racial tensions in society.

films.title: Safe
films.overview: Carol White, a Los Angeles housewife in the late 1980s, comes down with a debilitating illness with no clear diagnosis.

films.title: Poison
films.overview: A trio of interweaved transgressive tales, telling a bizarre stories of suburban patricide and a miraculous flight from justice, a mad sex experiment which unleashes a disfiguring plague, and the obsessive sexual relationship between two prison inmates.

films.title: May December
films.overview: Twenty years after their notorious tabloid romance gripped the nation, a married couple buckles under the pressure when an actress arrives to do research for a film about their past.

films.title: Carol
films.overview: In 1950s New York, a department-store clerk who dreams of a better life falls for an older, married woman.

films.title: Wonderstruck
films.overview: The story of a young boy in the Midwest is told simultaneously with a tale about a young girl in New York from fifty years ago as they both seek the same mysterious connection.

films.title: The Velvet Underground
films.overview: Experience the iconic rock band's legacy in the first major documentary to tell their story. Directed with the era’s avant-garde spirit by Todd Haynes, this kaleidoscopic oral history combines exclusive interviews with dazzling archival footage.

films.title: Dark Waters
films.overview: A tenacious attorney uncovers a dark secret that connects a growing number of unexplained deaths to one of the world's largest corporations. In the process, he risks everything — his future, his family, and his own life — to expose the truth.
